verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own repo includes a clipboard library (libs/clipboard) that implements file copy and paste on Windows, Linux and macOS, so first-party clipboard sync exists. However, nothing in the evidence documents text clipboard sync in both directions or a switch to turn clipboard sharing off. A hands-on report also says file copy-paste from Linux to Windows doesn't work. Missing for 10: documented bidirectional text clipboard sync, a documented per-session or global toggle to disable clipboard sharing, reliable cross-OS file clipboard corroboration.
